notes.title: Update 0.7.6
notes.content:
- A global AI has been introduced, triggering an enemy invasion scenario in all star systems. Now you can participate in battles for the system: defend it or lose it, as well as recapture points that have already been captured, destroying enemy stations and ships. 

- Balancing ships and improving their dynamics for smoother and more realistic controls. 

- Improved AI behavior in combat, making confrontations more interesting and challenging. 

- Fast and furious mode is implemented by pressing Tab for fast movement.

- Improved guns and their information systems to increase accuracy and efficiency. 

- Added a more visible entrance to the station to make it easier to navigate. 

- Redesigned the game launch process for a smoother start. 

- Track rings have been replaced with updated models with improved graphics. 

- Directional light indication is implemented in the track rings, which facilitates navigation. 

- There are anomalies in various systems, such as radiation zones and areas with high or low temperatures, adding variety and new tactical opportunities. 

- Mining of asteroids has been introduced: they can be destroyed by missiles and loot can be collected.

notes.title: Update 0.7.5
notes.content:
In this update, we have:

- Fixed an issue that caused the game to freeze on high-resolution and 4K monitors. 

- Fixed critical bugs to improve stability. 

- Optimized the universe and location generation processes for faster loading and smoother performance. 

- Ensured that the interface displays correctly on high-resolution and 4K monitors, with all elements scaled appropriately to avoid small and difficult-to-read icons. 

 Thank you for your support and feedback!
